statement: A pond lies northwest of the shelter, beyond the road and a field; its murky water can be scooped into a bottle.
Clean water is craftable from memory by boiling one water over a nearby fire or other boiling tool (about 5 minutes).
A campground north of the shelter has a picnic table area with a small tin can of 8 cheese spreads, smoked meat, a tomato, a lighter, flint, acorns, a short bow and a cigarette pack lying about.
A plastic bottle lay on the grass near the forest northwest of the road; the survivor picked it up and uses it to carry water.
A police-barricade roadblock lies on the road north of the shelter, with hostile zombies beyond it.
A zombie dog roams the open field northwest of the shelter.
A zombie child wanders near the campground by the road.
About four wild turkeys roam the forest north of the road.
Pond water can be purified by lighting a fire on the road with matches, burning cardboard and splintered wood, and boiling the water in the small tin can.
The survivor's fabrication skill reached 2 after practising carving; the in-progress carving was dropped in the shelter.
The shelter roof also holds planks, nails and scrap metal beside the snapped stick, which the survivor picked up.
A makeshift hammer needs a tool with hammering, a metal chunk and a stick or plank; a brazier needs sheet metal, so the survivor cannot yet make either.
The survivor saved and quit; Morgan Hale appears in the Brokaw Load list.

note: Walks outdoors wielding the intact stick.
Back in evac shelter B-05 at 8:37.
Odell Hampton seen again in the shelter.
Ate a protein ration from the carried stock.
Inspected the roof tank (56) while needing water.
Filled a plastic bottle from the tank, leaving 54.
Pickup menu of the cupboard with 21 boxes.
Took 5 more protein rations, now 6 carried.
Used the matchbook to start a fire.
